predictions.claim: the duty cycle moves the clock at a byte-identical kernel
predictions.numbers: every tread's under-load SM clock spans at least the ratio the design arithmetic below requires, across the duty states, with the same tensors, the same pinned tile and the same tread count in every state
predictions.fail: V1 FAILS and the arm is INVALID. Three states at one clock measure nothing, and the honest reading is that this container's governor does not respond to duty at this kernel -- not that the elasticity is zero.

predictions.claim: the measured per-call time is BELOW 0.25 in elasticity: most of a millisecond at this cell is traffic, not issue rate
predictions.numbers: the 95% interval on d log ms / d log f lies wholly below 0.25, which is the band in which the study's raw readings stand and pooled EXA alpha_b is near 0.974 with the BLOCK_M ladder monotone
predictions.fail: a FAIL is a RESULT and not a retry. Above 0.4 the BLOCK_M ladder is non-monotone, pooled alpha_b falls to about 0.93 and C3's DIRECTION is retracted; between the two the analysis registered no reading at all and the page says so instead of inventing one.

predictions.claim: and the design resolves which of the three registered worlds it is in
predictions.numbers: the 95% interval lies wholly inside ONE of the three bands, which needs a half-width under 0.075
predictions.fail: C1 FAILS. The apparatus worked and the answer is 'not resolved': the states separated too little or the repeats were too few, and NO registered consequence may be quoted off this page.

bands.name: RAW-STANDS
bands.consequence: the raw readings stand: pooled EXA alpha_b is near 0.974 and the 26.7-sigma monotone rise of alpha_b with BLOCK_M survives. The clock is not what is wrong with alpha; FORM and PHYSICS still are.

bands.name: UNREGISTERED-GAP
bands.consequence: NEITHER registered consequence is licensed. The analysis that produced the two readings below and above swept the elasticity past this band without stopping in it, so there is no pooled alpha_b to quote here and the honest report is the interval and the refusal to read it further.

bands.name: CLOCK-CARRIES
bands.consequence: the BLOCK_M ladder is NON-MONOTONE, pooled EXA alpha_b falls to about 0.93, and C3's DIRECTION is RETRACTED while C3's inequality survives. Every alpha in the study is then a blend of traffic and clock and none of them may be quoted as traffic.

instrument: scripts/clock_elasticity.py: bursts of N back-to-back fused_experts calls under one pinned tile, each call L2-flushed and bracketed by its own pre-primed event pair, the FIRST call of every burst discarded as a drained-queue launch, a host-side idle gap after each burst setting the sustained duty cycle, and the SM clock, board power and memory clock read through NVML with the burst still in flight; NOT timing.TIMING_BASIS
